import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXT = 62;
    static int R, C, T;
    static char[] c = new char[MAXT];
    static long[] r1score = new long[MAXT];
    static long[] rscore = new long[MAXT];
    static long[] lscore = new long[MAXT];
    static long mval;

    static Map<Pair, Long> mmap = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<Pair, Long> nmap = new HashMap<>();

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        int second;

        Pair(long first, int second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            Pair pair = (Pair) o;
            return first == pair.first && second == pair.second;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }

    static long choose(int x, int y) {
        if (y > x || y < 0) return 0;
        long res = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < y; i++) {
            res = res * (x - i);
            res = res / (i + 1);
        }
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        R = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = (2 * R + 2 * C);
        String line = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            c[i] = line.charAt(i);
        }

        Arrays.fill(lscore, 0);
        lscore[2 * R - 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2 * R; i < T; i++) {
            lscore[i] = lscore[i - 1] * i / (i - 2 * R + 1L);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= T; i++) {
            r1score[i] = choose(i, R - 1);
            rscore[i] = choose(i, R);
        }

        mval = 0;
        int acnt = 0, bcnt = 0;
        for (int i = T - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            boolean u = mval > 0;
            if (bcnt == T / 2)
                u = true;
            if (acnt == T / 2)
                u = false;

            if (u) {
                acnt++;
                mval -= r1score[T / 2 - acnt] * rscore[T / 2 - bcnt];
            } else {
                bcnt++;
                mval += r1score[T / 2 - bcnt] * rscore[T / 2 - acnt];
            }
        }
        mval = Math.max(mval, -mval);

        long tsum = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < T; i++) {
            tsum += lscore[i];
        }

        tsum = rscore[T / 2] * rscore[T / 2];

        mmap.clear();
        mmap.put(new Pair(0, 0), 1L);
        for (int i = T - 1; i >= 2 * R - 1; i--) {
            nmap.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
                Pair key = entry.getKey();
                long sum = key.first;
                int acnt_map = key.second;
                long ncount = entry.getValue();

                int aleft = T / 2 - acnt_map;
                int bleft = i + 1 - aleft;

                long asum = sum + r1score[aleft - 1] * rscore[bleft];
                long bsum = sum - r1score[bleft - 1] * rscore[aleft];

                if (c[i] == 'A') {
                    Pair newKey1 = new Pair(asum, acnt_map + 1);
                    nmap.put(newKey1, nmap.getOrDefault(newKey1, 0L) + ncount);
                    // nmap[{bsum, acnt}] += 0; // skip
                } else if (c[i] == 'B') {
                    // nmap[{asum, acnt + 1}] += 0; // skip
                    Pair newKey2 = new Pair(bsum, acnt_map);
                    nmap.put(newKey2, nmap.getOrDefault(newKey2, 0L) + ncount);
                } else { // c[i] == '?'
                    Pair newKey1 = new Pair(asum, acnt_map + 1);
                    nmap.put(newKey1, nmap.getOrDefault(newKey1, 0L) + ncount);
                    Pair newKey2 = new Pair(bsum, acnt_map);
                    nmap.put(newKey2, nmap.getOrDefault(newKey2, 0L) + ncount);
                }
            }
            tsum -= lscore[i];

            mmap.clear();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : nmap.entrySet()) {
                Pair key = entry.getKey();
                long sum = key.first;
                int acnt_n = key.second;
                long ncount = entry.getValue();

                int aleft = T / 2 - acnt_n;
                int bleft = i - aleft;
                if (acnt_n > (T / 2) || (T - i - acnt_n) > (T / 2))
                    continue;
                long lsum = rscore[aleft] * rscore[bleft];
                if (sum < (-mval - lsum) || sum > (mval + lsum))
                    continue;
                Pair newKey = new Pair(sum, acnt_n);
                mmap.put(newKey, mmap.getOrDefault(newKey, 0L) + ncount);
            }
        }

        long bscore = (long) 1e18;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            bscore = Math.min(bscore, Math.max(sum, -sum));
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair, Long> entry : mmap.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            int acnt_map = entry.getKey().second;
            long ncount = entry.getValue();

            if (sum == bscore || sum == -bscore) {
                int nleft = 0;
                int acnt_final = acnt_map;
                for (int i = 0; i < 2 * R - 1; i++) {
                    if (c[i] == 'A')
                        acnt_final++;
                    if (c[i] == '?')
                        nleft++;
                }

                ncount *= choose(nleft, T / 2 - acnt_final);
                ans += ncount;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
